issue.title: cabinets-chrome test 'album Schema is closed when healthy and still resurfaces on problems' fails since 15c2410d made cabinets start closed
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-ra.5 (note #3, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) and triaged by the bob-cli-ra land agent.

## What fails

`npm test` in bob-plugins fails exactly one unit test on master a6f7691e (10,465 tests: 10,459 pass, 1 fail, 5 skipped):

`scripts/test-ledger-tools-cabinets-chrome.cjs` — `album Schema is closed when healthy and still resurfaces on problems` (line ~287). The second assertion,
`plugin.albumHeaderIsExpanded("eat.md", { schemaInvalid: true, issues: [{ severity: "error", ... }] })`, returns `false` where the test expects `true`.

## Root cause

bob-plugins `15c2410d` ("feat(ledger-tools): cabinets start closed, configurable per card type", agent bbugyi200.athena.1hk, no bead) rewrote `albumHeaderIsExpanded` in `plugins/bob-ledger-tools/src/241v-plugin-album-header.js`. It no longer computes `albumHeaderFoldProblems(model)`. It passes `problems: ""` to `propertyCardFoldResolve` and takes `foldDefault` from `propertyCardCabinetDefaultOpen("schema", { species: "album" })`. A schema problem therefore no longer opens the Schema cabinet. That matches the new contract in bob-cli `glossary:cabinet` (f3b231a8): "Every cabinet starts closed ... Problems show only in the closed header's chip, summary, and Sync action." The commit updated `test-ledger-tools-album-header.cjs` but not this chrome test, so the test still pins the old "resurfaces on problems" contract.

## Fix

Decide which contract wins (most likely the new one, which the glossary and `docs/cabinets.md` now state). Then either update the test to assert that Schema stays closed on problems and the problem shows in the closed header chip, or restore problem resurfacing in `albumHeaderIsExpanded` and update the docs and glossary to match. Run `npm run build`, `npm run build:check`, and `npm test`, then `bob plugins sync` if any plugin source changes.
